2:142: Ad inin ijeɣlufen, ger medden: "acu iten iswexxṛen si lqibla nnsen, uɣuṛ llan ţẓallan"? Ini: "N Ṛebbi agmuḍ akked utaram. Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim".
2:143: Akka ay kwen Nerra d lois alemmas, iwakken a ţţilim d inagan n medden, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen. Nerra lqibla uɣuṛ teţţezziḍ, iwakken kan a Nẓeṛ anwa iddan d Umazan, anwa iuɣalen ar deffir. D lhejna, siwa i wid Inha Ṛebbi. Ur Iḍeggiɛ Ṛebbi liman nnwen. Ih, Ṛebbi, i yimdanen, d Umɛin, Iţḥunu.
2:144: Niɣ Nwala, tezziḍ udem ik ar igenni. A k Nawi ar lqibla ara tṛaḍiḍ. Ezzi udem ik ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen ɣuṛes. Ih, wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, ẓṛan ţ d tideţ sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen xeddmen.
2:145: Xas a d tawiḍ, i wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, yal assekni, ur tezzin ar lqibla k. Kečč, ur tezzi ar lqibla nnsen. Kra segsen, ur tezzin ar lqibla n wiyaḍ. Ma teddiḍ akked usirem nnsen, mbaɛd ma tusa k id, sɣuṛneɣ, tussna, a ţţiliḍ, imiren, seg imednas.
2:146: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt ssnen ţ, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. War ccekk, arbaɛ segsen teffren tideţ, u nitni ẓṛan.
2:147: Tideţ sɣuṛ Mass ik, ur ţţili seg wid iţcukkun.
2:148: I yal yiwen, loiha uɣuṛ izzi. Sɛut timenyugert ar lxiṛ. Anda teddam, ad Yili Ṛebbi yidwen akw. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer i yal cci.
2:149: Ansi d tusiḍ, ezzi udem ik ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam. Neţţat, ih, d tideţ sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen txeddmem.
2:150: Ansi d tefɣeḍ, zzi udem ik ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen nnwen ɣuṛes, iwakken ur kwen ţnamaren imdanen, siwa wid idensen, segsen. Ur ten ţţagwadet, agwadet iyI. Ad awen Timeɣ lɣit iW, amar a ţţeţwanhum.
2:151: Akken i wen Nuzen Amazan segwen, immal awen issekniyen nneɣ, izzizdig ikwen, isselmad awen Tazmamt, akked ṣṣwab; isselmad awen ayen ur tessinem.
2:152: Mmektit iyI d, a kwen id Mmektiɣ. Snemmret iyI, ur jehlet.
2:153: A wid iumnen! Ssutret tallalt, s ṣṣbeṛ akked tẓallit. Ih, Ṛebbi ar iṣebṛiyen.
2:154: Ur qqaṛet mmuten wid iţwanɣan deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Xaṭi d imuddiren, maca ur teḥṣim ara.
2:155: War ccekk, a kwen Njeṛṛeb s kra usigwed, n llaẓ, n nneqs n wayla, n leṛwaḥ, n lɣellat. Ssefreḥ iṣebṛiyen;
2:156: Wid, ma uɣen tawaɣit, qqaṛen: "nekwni n Ṛebbi, nekwni, a nuɣal ɣuṛeS".
2:157: Widak, fellasen tẓilla sɣuṛ Mass nnsen, akked uḥunu. Widak d wid iţwanhan.
2:158: Ih, Ṣafa akked Meṛwa, seg isekkiren n Ṛebbi. Win iḥuoen s Axxam, neɣ iẓuṛ it, ulac uɣilif fellas, ma izzi yasent. Yif it win izzin, s lebɣi s. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţţara tajmilt, d Amusnaw.
2:159: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Nessers ubeggen akked nnhaya, mbaɛd ma Nbeggen it i yimdanen, di Tezmamt, widak, Ixza iten Ṛebbi, xzan ten wid ixezzun.
2:160: Kkes ed wid inedmen u xedmen ayen ilhan, u beggnen d. Widak, ad asen Ssurfeɣ. Nek Ssurufeɣ, Pḥunuɣ.
2:161: Ih, wid ijehlen u mmuten d ijehliyen, widak, fellasen xezzu n Ṛebbi, lmalayek, akked yimdanen, meṛṛa.
2:162: Degs ad wekkṛen. Ur iţţifsus fellasen uɛaqeb, ur illi w ara ten id iwalin.
2:163: Ṛebbi nnwen d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Aḥnin Iţḥunun.
2:164: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan: afraz ger yiḍ akked wass, lbabuṛ iţţazalen di yill, s wayen infɛan medden, ayen id Issers Ṛebbi n waman, seg igenni - Issidir yissen tamurt, deffir tmeţţant is, Issenkar, degs, yal lweḥc -, abeddel n waḍu akked usigna i imuḥeţmen ad yili ger igenni akked tmurt. War cekk, ard issekniyen i ugdud iţmeyyizen.
2:165: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iţţadamen tanudda, war Ṛebbi. Ḥemmlen ten akken Iţţuḥemmel Ṛebbi. Wid iumnen zaden akken ḥemmlen Ṛebbi. Awufan wid idensen, mi walan aɛaqeb, ad ẓṛen ar tazmert akw n Ṛebbi, u Ṛebbi Iqseḥ deg uɛaqeb.
2:166: Mara zekkṛen uḍfiṛen nnsen, wid iţwatebɛan, u walan aɛaqeb, u tfukk yidsen lemxalṭa,
2:167: ad inin uḍfiṛen: "a lemmer a nuɣal, a ten nzekkeṛ akken i ɣ zekkṛen"! Akka ay sen Issken Ṛebbi igiten nnsen. A yamxix nnsen, ur d teffɣen si tmes!
2:168: A yimdanen! Eččet seg wayen iḥellen, imaɛnen, di tmurt. Ur teddut di lateṛ n Cciṭan. Neţţa, s tideţ, d acengu nnwen n ṣṣeḥ.
2:169: Iţţameṛ awen kan tuccḍa, lɛaṛ; a ţţinim, ɣef Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
2:170: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issers Ṛebbi", a d inin: "xaṭi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nneɣ". I ma llan imezwura nnsen ur meyyzen acemma, ur ţwanhan?
2:171: Amedya n wid ijehlen, d amedya n win uɣuṛ ţţuɣun, seg akken ur issel, siwa i usuɣu akked uberreḥ. D iɛeẓẓugen, d igugam, d iderɣalen, nitni ur ţmeyyizen.
2:172: A wid iumnen! Eččet si tẓidanin ikwen Nɣat. Snemmret Ṛebbi, ma d Neţţa ay tɛabdem.
2:173: I awen Igdel Ṛebbi, siwa loifa, idamen, aksum n yilef, akked ṭḥegga i war Ṛebbi. Win terra tmara, ur ibɣi, ur izgir tilas, ur illi d abekkaḍ is. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:174: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Issers Ṛebbi, si Tezmamt, ţţaɣen yis ayen ṛxisen, widak, siwa times ara ččen, deg iɛabbaḍ nnsen. Ur asen Iţmeslay Ṛebbi, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
2:175: Widak, d wid iuɣen ttelfan s nnhaya, aɛaqeb s ssmaḥ. Acu ara ten iṣebbṛen si tmes?
2:176: Akka, acku Issers ed Ṛebbi Tazmamt, s tideţ. Ih, wid imgarraden ɣef Tezmamt, haaten di lfiṛaq uɣmiq.
2:177: Iseɣ, mačči ma tezzim udmawen nnwen, ar ugmuḍ akked utaram. Maca, iseɣ d wid iumnen s Ṛebbi, s wass aneggaru, s lmalayek, s Tazmamt, s lambiyya. U ţţaken ayla, ɣef lemḥibba S, i llzem, igujilen, igellilen, win d ibbwi ubrid, imaţţaren, akw i uberru n waklan. D wid iţẓallan, iţzekkin, iţţaṭṭafen di lemɛahda nnsen, ma ɛahden, iṣebṛiyen di lmeḥna akked twaɣit, di tegwniţ n ccqa. D wigi i illan di tideţ, d wigi i iţḥezziben.
2:178: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen ţţaṛ n tmegraḍ. Lḥeṛṛ s lḥeṛṛ, akli s wakli, nnta s nnta. Win iwumi isemmeḥ gma s kra: ṭlaba s lewqama, feddu s lewqama. Ayagi, d sshala sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, akked uḥunu. Win iffɣen abrid, deffir waya, ad isɛaddi aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
2:179: I kunwi, ţţaṛ d tameddurt, a yuɛqilen. Amar a ţḥezzbem.
2:180: Iura fellawen: ma tusa d tmeţţant, ar yiwen degwen, ma iooa d lxiṛ, a t ifk i imawlan is, akked llzem, s lqanun. D ayen ilezmen i wid iţḥezziben.
2:181: Win it ibeddlen mbaɛd ma isla yas, abekkaḍ is siwa ɣef wid it iţbeddilen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:182: Ur idnib win iten issemṣalaḥen acku iugad rrya, neɣ abekkaḍ, sɣuṛ win iţţuweṣṣan. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:183: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen uẓummu, akken iura ɣef imezwura nnwen, amar a ţḥezzbem.
2:184: Ussan iţwaḥesben. Win iuḍnen segwen neɣ illan iţţinig, annect n wussan nniḍen. Wid i s izemren, feddu ad cceččen igellil. Win izaden lxiṛ, ilha yas. Ma tuẓamem, ţţif i kunwi, lemmer teẓṛim.
2:185: Aggur n Ṛemḍan, ideg d irs Leqwṛan, d nnhaya i medden, d abeggen n nnhaya akked ufraz. Win segwen iwalan illul ed waggur, a t iuzum. Win iuḍnen neɣ illan iţţinig, annect n wussan nniḍen. Ṛebbi Ibɣa yawen sshala, ur awen Ibɣa ara cedda. A ţfukem tallit, a ţkabrem Ṛebbi imi kwen Inha, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
2:186: Ma steqsan k, imdanen iW, fellI, Nek Qeṛbeɣ. Pjawabeɣ i unuju n yimsuter, ma iţţer iyI. Ihi, ad iyI d jawben, ad amnen yissI, amar ad ţwanhun.
2:187: Iḥell awen, deg iḍ uẓummu, a ţqeṛṛbem ar tlawin nnwen. Nitenti d lebsa nnwen, kunwi d lebsa nnsent. Iẓṛa Ṛebbi ar tellam teţkellixem iman nnwen. Issuref awen, Isemmeḥ awen. Tura qeṛṛbet ɣuṛsent, nadit ayen i wen Iura Ṛebbi. Eččet, esswet, ar ţferzem lxiḍ amellal, si lxiḍ aberkan, di tafrara. Sinna, uẓummet ar yiḍ. Ur ţqeṛṛibet ɣuṛsent, ma tɛazlem iman nnwen di lowamaɛ. D tigi ay d tilas n Ṛebbi. Ur ţqeṛṛibet ɣuṛsent! Akka i Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen iS i yimdanen, amar ad ḥezzben.
2:188: Ur ţţemyeččat ayla nnwen, garawen, d aḥerfi, ur t ţţaket i yimḥaddan, iwakken a ţţeččem amur, seg wayla n medden, di lmenkweṛ, u kunwi teẓṛam.
2:189: La k steqsayen ɣef tlalit n waggur. Ini: "d lewqat i medden, u i lḥio". Iseɣ, mačči d anekcum ar ixxamen si zdeffir nnsent. Maca, iseɣ d aḥezzeb i Ṛebbi. Kecmet ixxamen si tebbura nnsen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem.
2:190: Nnaɣet deg ubrid n Ṛebbi wid i kwen iţnaɣen. Ur zegret tilas. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
2:191: Nnaɣet ţen anda ten tufam, ssuffɣet ţen seg wanda i kwen ssuffɣen. Ahewwel iwɛaṛ kteṛ umennuɣ. Ur ten neţnaɣet ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, siwa ma nnuɣen kwen degs. Ma nnuɣen kwen, nnaɣet ţen. Akka aqeṭṭi ijehliyen.
2:192: Ma fukken, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:193: Nnaɣet ţen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iuɣal ddin i Ṛebbi. Ma fukken, ur ţnaɣet, siwa imednas.
2:194: Aggur iṛqan s waggur iṛqan. Tiririt n ţţaṛ ɣef wayen iţţugedlen. Win ikwen id ibbwḍen, awḍet eţ, akken ikwen id ibbweḍ. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Cfut ar Ṛebbi ar wid iţḥezziben.
2:195: Ssedqet deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ur d ţţawit tawaɣit, s ifassen nnwen. Maɛnet. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel iɛaṛḍiyen.
2:196: Ṛuḥet ar lḥio akked lɛumṛa, i Ṛebbi. Ma tḥeṣlem, ssadaqa tushilt. Ur ţseṭṭilet iqweṛṛa nnwen, ar ţţaweḍ tikci s amkan is. Win iuḍnen, segwen, neɣ ihlek aqeṛṛu s, ad ifdu s uẓummu, neɣ ssadaqa, neɣ iseflan. Mi tellam di laman, win izuṛen ur iḥuo, ad iseddeq ayen i s isehlen. Win ur nufa ara, ad iuẓum kraḍ wussan di lḥio, ṣa wussan ar tuɣalin, akken ad awḍen mraw. Ayagi i win ur nesɛi tawacult illan ar Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, cfut ar Ṛebbi Iwɛaṛ deg uɛaqeb.
2:197: Lḥio deg wagguren iţwassnen. Win iɛazmen, degsen, ad iḥuo, ihi, di lḥio ur telli tuzzuft, neɣ ayen n dir, neɣ nnmara. Ayen txedmem n lxiṛ, Iẓṛa t Ṛebbi. Awit aɛwin, maca aɛwin amxallef d aḥezzeb. Ḥezzbet iyI a yuɛqilen!
2:198: Uu ili uɣilif fellawen ma tessarmem lfeḍl sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Mi d tṣubbem si Aɛṛafat, mmektit ed Ṛebbi, ţţama n lemqam iṛqan. Mmektit eP id, akken i kwen Inha, wanag tellam, uqbel, seg imɣeṛṛqen.
2:199: Sinna, ddut anda ddan medden, ssutret ssmaḥ i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:200: Mi tfukkem isekkiren nnwen, mmektit ed Ṛebbi, akken d tesmektayem imezwura nnwen, neɣ kteṛ. Ger imdanen, wid iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Efk aɣ di ddunit". Ur ţţawin amur di laxeṛt.
2:201: Llan, garasen, wid iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Efk aɣ di ddunit, iseɣ, di laxeṛt, iseɣ. Esseṛ aɣ seg uɛaqeb n tmes".
2:202: Widak, ad awin amur seg wayen kesben. Ṛebbi Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
2:203: Mmektit ed Ṛebbi, deg ussan iɛuden. Win iɣawlen di sin wussan, ur icciḍ ara; win iɛaṭlen, ur icciḍ ara, ma illa d win iţḥezziben. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Cfut, ar ɣuṛeS ara teţwafesrem.
2:204: Yiwen ger imdanen, iɛoeb ik umeslay is, ɣef tmeddurt n ddunit. Irra Ṛebbi d Anagi, ɣef wayen illan deg ul is. U neţţa iqseḥ i tilla.
2:205: Mi izzi, ad ikkat di tmurt, iwakken ad issefsed degs, ad isqucc igran akked lmal. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara asefsed.
2:206: Ma nnan as: "ḥezzeb i Ṛebbi"! A t tekcem lqwedṛa ubekkaḍ. Ad isteqnaɛ s Loahennama. A yir usu!
2:207: Ger imdanen, win izzenzen iman is, issaram llza n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Umɛin ar imdanen.
2:208: A wid iumnen! Kecmet di tifrat s lekmal is, ur teddut d lateṛ n Cciṭan. Neţţa, s tideţ, d acengu nnwen n ṣṣeḥ.
2:209: Ma teccḍem, deffir n tisin ubeggen ɣuṛwen, cfut Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
2:210: Day a ţṛaoun kan, ad asen d Ias Ṛebbi, akked lmalayek, di tili usigna? Ad iṣaṛ lameṛ. Ar Ṛebbi ara uɣalen lumuṛ.
2:211: Steqsi At Isṛail, acḥal issekniyen iberrzen i sen Nefka. I win iţbeddilen tikci n Ṛebbi, deffir tisin is ɣuṛes, ihi, Ṛebbi Iqseḥ deg uɛaqeb.
2:212: Wid ijehlen, ccebḥen asen tameddurt n ddunit. Ttihin ɣef wid iumnen. Wid iţḥezziben ad ilin sennig sen, ass n tnekra. Ṛebbi Iţɣiti win i S ihwan, s lufa.
2:213: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois. Iuzen ed Ṛebbi lambiyya ad beccṛen, ad nabin. Issers ed, yidsen, Tazmamt s tideţ, iwakken ad Iḥudd ger medden, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden. I imgarraden fellas, siwa wid iwumi teţţunefk, mbaɛd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Pţemyasamen. Inha Ṛebbi wid iumnen deg wayen n tideţ, iɣef mgarraden, s tsriḥ iS. Ṛebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim.
2:214: Day tɣilem a ţkecmem Loennet, wanag ur kwen id iusi wayen id iusan ar wid i kwen id izwaren? Mmugren d lmeḥna, ccqa, zzelzla, armi inna umazan akked wid iumnen yides: "melmi laɛnaya n Ṛebbi"? Day, s tideţ, ur d teqṛib ara laɛnaya n Ṛebbi?
2:215: Steqsan k ɣef wayen ara fken. Ini: "ayen ara tefkem n lxiṛ, i imawlan, i llzem, i igujilen, i igellilen, i w ar d iawi ubrid". Ayen ara txedmem n lxiṛ, war ccekk, Iẓṛa t Ṛebbi.
2:216: Iura fellawen umennuɣ, u neţţa d ayen tkeṛhem. Ahat tkeṛhem ayen ilhan i kunwi, ahat tḥemmlem ayen n dir i kunwi. Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
2:217: La k steqsayen ma ad yili umennuɣ deg waggur iṛqan. Ini: "amennuɣ degs, d abekkaḍ. Abekkaḍ it iɣelben, ar Ṛebbi, d assefṛeɣ ɣef ubrid n Ṛebbi, d ankaṛ is, u d ankaṛ n Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam; d assuffeɣ, segs, imezdaɣ is". Ahewwel iɣleb amennuɣ. Zgan a kwen ţnaɣen, alamma swexxṛen kwen, ma zemren, si ddin nnwen. Win, segwen, iffɣen i ddin is, ad immet d ajehli. Widak, mḥan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Widak, d at tmes, degs, nitni, ad wekkṛen.
2:218: Ih, wid iumnen, win iunagen u juhden deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, widak ggunin aḥunu n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:219: La k steqsayen ɣef ccṛab akked leqwmeṛ. Ini: "degsen abekkaḍ meqqwṛen, akked ibuɣar i medden. Abekkaḍ nnsen iɣleb ibuɣar nsen". La k steqsayen, acu ara seddqen. Ini: "ayen iugaren". Akka i wen Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen, amar a ţmeyyzem
2:220: af ddunit akked laxeṛt. La k steqsayen ɣef igujilen. Ini: "ţţif ma txedmem asen lxiṛ. Ma txulḍem ten, d atmaten nnwen". Ṛebbi Ifrez ger ufessad akked uɛaṛḍi. Ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi, a kwen Icebbwel. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
2:221: Ur ţţaɣet timcurak alamma umnent. Taklit iumnen tif tamcarekt, xas taɛoeb ikwen. Ur ţnasabet imcurak alamma umnen. Akli iumnen yif amcarek, xas iaɛoeb ikwen. Widak, neccden ar tmes. Ṛebbi Inecced ar Loennet akked ssmaḥ, ma Irad. Iţbeggin issekniyen iS i medden, amar a d mmektin.
2:222: La k steqsayen ɣef tarda. Ini: "d aṭan. Ɛazlet tilawin di tarda, ur ţqeṛṛibet ɣuṛsent alamma ṣfant. Mi ṣfant, qeṛṛbet ɣuṛsent, akken i wen Iumeṛ Ṛebbi". Ih, Ṛebbi Iḥemmel wid iutuben, Iḥemmel wid izzizdigen.
2:223: Tilawin nnwen d aḥṛiq n tyerza nnwen. Melmi tebɣam, aset s aḥṛiq nnwen. Zzewret lxiṛ i yiman nnwen, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Cfut ar kunwi a T temmagrem. Becceṛ lmumnin.
2:224: Ur ssekcamet Ṛebbi mara teggallem a ţţizdigem, a ţḥezzbem, a ţţessemṣalḥem medden. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:225: Ur kwen Iţqissi ara Ṛebbi ɣef tgallit ɣef awal. Maca, a kwen Iqiss ɣef wayen kesben wulawen nnwen. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iḥellem.
2:226: Wid iggullen ur ţqeṛṛiben ar tlawin nnsen, ad gganin kuẓ wagguren. Ma bedlen ṛṛay, ihi, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
2:227: Ma ɛazmen berru, ihi, Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:228: Timnufaq ad aṛount kraḍ tardiwin. Ur asent iḥell ara ad ffrent ayen Ixleq Ṛebbi, di tɛabbaḍ nnsent, ma umnent s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma bɣan irgazen nnsent ad mṣalaḥen, izzewr iten lḥal a tent id rren, di lmudda nni. Akken ţwalasent ay ţţalasent, s lqanun. I yirgazen, asurif ɣer loiha nnsent. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
2:229: Berru, sin iberdan; tiririt, s lqanun; aserreḥ s lewqama. Ur awen iḥell ara a ţţedmem kra, seg wayen i sent tefkam - siwa ma ugaden ur ţqadaṛen ara tilas n Ṛebbi. Ma tugadem ur ţqadaṛen ara tilas n Ṛebbi, ulac uɣilif fellasen ɣef wayen is ara d tefdu iman is. D tigi ay d tilas n Ṛebbi, ur tent zegret. Wid izegren tilas n Ṛebbi, widak, d imednas.
2:230: Ma ibra yas, ur as tḥell, imiren, alamma tuɣ argaz nniḍen. Ma ibra yas, ulac uɣilif fellasen ma uɣalen ar din, ma walan qudṛen tilas n Ṛebbi. D tigi ay d tilas n Ṛebbi. Ibeggen itent i ugdud issnen.
2:231: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sɛaddant tallit nnsent, erret ţent id, s lqanun, neɣ serrḥet asent, s lqanun. Ur tent ţţarat s uḥeţţem, a ţţeccḍem. Win ixedmen akka, idens iman is. Ur ţţuraret s issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Mmektit ed ayen i kwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, akked wayen i wen d Issers si Tezmamt, akw si ṣṣwab. Iţnabi kwen yis. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
2:232: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sɛaddant tallit nnsent, ur asent tekset ad aɣent irgazen nnsent, ma mwafaqen s lqanun. Ar waya ay ţwanecden wid, segwen, iumnen s Ṛebbi, akked wass aneggaru. Pţif akka, i tezdeg akked ṣṣfawa nnwen. Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
2:233: Tiyimmatin ad ssuṭḍent arraw nnsent, sin iseggwasen mden, i win ibɣan ad itim ussuṭeḍ. ɣef ubabat, lmakla akked lebsa nnsent, s lqanun. Ur iţwakellaf yiman siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Tarwa ur teṭṭuṛṛu imma s, ur teṭṭuṛṛu baba s. I uweṛṛat, am akka. Ma bɣan ad kksen tuṭṭḍa, mcawaṛen, ulac uɣilif fellasen. Ma tebɣam tamṛebbit, a ţţessuṭṭeḍ tarwa nnwen, ulac uɣilif fellawen, ma txelṣem ayen i wen ilaqen, s lqanun. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
2:234: Wid, segwen, issuffɣen taṛwiḥt, u ooan d tilawin, ad aṛount kuẓ wagguren akked mraw wussan. Mi sɛaddant tallit nnsent, ulac uɣilif fellawen deg wayen xedment deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
2:235: Ulac uɣilif fellawen, ma tennam d a ţxeḍbem tilawin, neɣ ma teffrem. Iẓṛa Ṛebbi, ar tesmektayem tent id. Maca, ur asent ɛahdet, di tbaḍnit, siwa ma tennam awal uwqim. Ur ferrut ɣef lemlak, alamma ibbweḍ lajel iuran. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan degwen. Ḥadret iman nnwen segS. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iḥellem.
2:236: Ulac uɣilif fellawen ma tebram i tlawin ur tennulem, neɣ iwumi ur tefkim lwajeb. Efket asent tikci iweqmen. Asɛay s tezmert is, igellil s tezmert is. D lwajeb i iɛaṛḍiyen.
2:237: Ma tebram asent, uqbel a tent tennalem, u, iuɣ lḥal, tefkam asent lwajeb, ihi, azgen n wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma semḥent, neɣ isemmeḥ usemsaṛ n jjwao. Ssmaḥ iqṛeb nezzeh ar uḥezzeb. Ur teţţut lfeḍl garawen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
2:238: Ḥarbet ɣef tẓilla, u taẓallit talemmast. Beddet i Ṛebbi, s wannuz.
2:239: Ma tugadem, s ibeddi, neɣ di rrekba. Ma tellam di laman, mmektit ed Ṛebbi, akken i wen Isselmed ayen ur tessinem.
2:240: Wid segwen issuffɣen taṛwiḥt, u ooan d tilawin, ad asent ḍemnen aseggwas n wučči, ur tent ssuffuɣen. Ma ffɣent, ulac uɣilif fellawen, deg wayen xedment, deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
2:241: I tembwurab taqḍiɛt, s lqanun. D lwajeb ɣef wid iţḥezziben.
2:242: Akka i wen Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen iS, amar a ţḥemṣem.
2:243: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iffɣen, seg ixxamen nnsen, d igima, ugaden tameţţant. Inna yasen Ṛebbi: "emmtet"! Sinna, Issader ten id. S tideţ, Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ɣef yimdanen, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
2:244: Nnaɣet deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Cfut ar Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
2:245: Win iṛeḍlen aṛeṭṭal umɛin i Ṛebbi, ad as t id Irr s lufa. Ṛebbi Iţţaṭaf, Ismiri. ɣuṛeS a ţţuɣalem.
2:246: Day ur twalaḍ ara imḍebbṛen seg wAt Isṛail, deffir Musa? Mi nnan i nnbi nnsen: "azen aɣ d agellid, a nennaɣ deg ubrid n Ṛebbi". Inna: "ma iura fellawen umennuɣ, day a ţţagim a ţţennaɣem"? Nnan: "ur aɣ issefk ara a neqqim ur neţnaɣ ara, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Niɣ ssuffɣen aɣ d, nekwni akked tarwa nneɣ, seg ixxamen nneɣ". Mi iura fellasen umennuɣ, wexxṛen, siwa drus segsen. Ṛebbi Issen imednas.
2:247: Inna yasen nnbi nnsen: "Niɣ Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iuzen awen d Ṭalut, d agellid". Nnan: "amek ara yili d agellid nneɣ? Nezwar it akken neklal tagelda. Ur as iţţunefk wayla". Inna: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ifren it garawen, u Irna yas aṭas n tmusni akked loeţţa". Iţţak Ṛebbi tagelda S i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
2:248: Inna yasen, nnbi nnsen: "s tideţ, assekni n tgelda s, d tisin ɣuṛwen usenduq. Degs talwit sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, akked wayen id igwran, seg wayen id teooa twacult n Musa, akked tin n Haṛun. A t id awint lmalayek. Ih, deg waya, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
2:249: Mi iffeɣ Ṭalut, s lɛaskeṛ, inna: "Ṛebbi, s tideţ, a kwen Ijeṛṛeb s wasif. Win iswan segs, ur illi yidi. Win ur neswi, neţţa, s tideţ, yidi. Kkes ed win iswan cwiṭ, deg ufus is". Swan segs, siwa ixeṭṭayen segsen. Mi zegren, neţţa akked wid iumnen yides, nnan: "ur nezmir assa, i Oalut akked lɛaskeṛ is". Nnan wid issarmen ar nitni ad mlilen d Ṛebbi: "acḥal d abrid, ṭayfa tameẓẓyant teɣleb ṭayfa tameqwṛant, ma Irad Ṛebbi". Ṛebbi ar iṣebṛiyen.
2:250: Mi qublen Oalut akked lɛaskeṛ is, nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Azen aɣ d ṣṣbeṛ, Tebbet isurifen nneɣ, Awes aɣ mgal agdud ijehliyen".
2:251: Irad Ṛebbi, rebḥen ten. Dawed inɣa Oalut. Ifka yas Ṛebbi tagelda akked ṣṣwab. Isselmed as seg wayen i S ihwan. Lemmer ur Issemnamar ara Ṛebbi, imdanen, a ţţefsed tmurt. Maca, Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ɣef imaḍalen.
2:252: Atnan issekniyen n Ṛebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tideţ. Kečč, war ccekk, seg imazanen.
